intro.text: Denth's band of mercenaries in T'Telir, Tonk Fah among them, who have been working for the Idrian agent Lemex.
A band of mercenaries in T'Telir led by Denth, with Tonk Fah, Jewels and their Lifeless, Clod, whom Vivenna hires to help her weaken Hallandren's ability to wage war.
A band of mercenaries in T'Telir led by Denth, hired to start a war between Hallandren and Idris, who used Vivenna while posing as her hired help.

description.text: Denth and Tonk Fah keep insisting they are mere mercenaries, in it for the money rather than any cause.
Jewels, the one woman in the crew, is a Drab, so even people whose Breath sharpens their life sense cannot sense her.

items.text: Before Vivenna came, Bluefingers had hired the crew to raise tensions between Hallandren and Idris and drive Hallandren to war. Denth took work with Lemex, the Idrian ambassador, to get close to the city's Idrians, and corrupted and used him.
Hearing that Vivenna was coming, Denth saw her as a fallback pawn and began poisoning Lemex, who had been less pliable, so the crew could take her in hand.
Denth and Tonk Fah met Vivenna in Lemex's place and took her to his sickbed, where they persuaded her to accept his Breath.

Afterwards they told her their contract, and Jewels', had been half paid, so they still owed some weeks of work. Since they had left Lemex's hidden gold alone, she trusted them and hired them herself.

From a house in a wealthy district, the crew dealt with crime lords and disrupted the city's food supply, which Denth said was all that remained of Vahr's cause. Vivenna disliked their Lifeless, Clod, but Denth refused to part with him.
They met merchants, crime lords and politicians, using Vivenna's Royal Locks to prove who she was.

Vivenna joined them in robbing a salt merchant, with a fire and an attack on a priest's carriage as cover, and in hiring forgers to fake proof that certain priests were extorting Idris. On a visit to the Idrian slums the city watch raided their meeting, and Clod saved her.
That night, back at the safe house, Vasher kidnapped Vivenna, believing her to be in league with Denth.

Escaping Vasher, Vivenna returned to the safe house, found Parlin dead in the cellar and realized the crew had been manipulating her all along. Confronted by Denth and Tonk Fah, she used Clod's security phrase to set him on Denth and fled.
Denth put a price on her head. After weeks on the streets as a Drab she was caught by thugs, but Vasher rescued her before they could hand her over.
Vasher told Vivenna that Denth had been hired, by someone unknown, to start a war, and showed her how the crew had used her to push the priests toward it.

Together they worked out that the salt robbery hid the crew's real aim: seizing the daughter of Nanrovah, Stillmark's high priest, to force him to vote for war. They freed the girl and returned her to her father, who again argued against war.

While the Pantheon met to vote on war, Denth's mercenaries killed the guards at Siri's door and Denth trapped Vasher, threw Nightblood into the bay and tortured Vasher in revenge for killing Shashara.
Vivenna helped Vasher escape. In their final duel Denth had the upper hand until Vasher forced his last Breaths into him; the rush of pleasure gave Vasher the opening to kill him.
